{{Quote|Kenth, we're getting indications that the Yuuzhan Vong could be getting ready to hit Duro, and it's too vital a system to lose. If millions of lives weren't reason enough, it's actually inside the Core. From here, they could block trade on the Spine, too.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Kenth Hamner]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Balance Point">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>}}
The '''Duro system''', also known as the '''Duros system''', was a three-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].

==History==
The Duro system was filled with vast orbiting cities and [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] governed by the stockholders of these [[Starship/Legends|shipbuilding]] corporations.

The [[Pellezara station]] was located in the Duro system, a maintenance stopover for ships en route to Duro.<ref name="GG3" />
